method: full-text archive (agent/terms-archive, 2026-11-25): every archived terms/help paragraph matching the discretion, sanction, rule-change, separate-agreement, asymmetry and consistency lexicons reviewed by hand; sanction clauses re-read in the full text

facts.text: Funded accounts are run under the rules of OneUp’s funding partners (‘strictly prohibited by our funding partners’; account holds must be requested from the funding partner); the funding partner agreement is not published.
facts.locator: Funded Trader Rules (PDF saved by Geyer, 25 Nov 2026)

facts.text: Funded traders must keep weekly trade executions at no less than 50% of their evaluation average, and during a 30-day probation must be above the starting balance at each 15-day check; failure risks termination.
